what_it_does: Modern data centers combine two powerful trends: hardware disaggregation (separating storage, computation, and networking into independent pools) and heterogeneous accelerators (specialized processors for different tasks like GPUs or custom silicon). Most existing systems support either disaggregated homogeneous CPUs or heterogeneous accelerators within single servers, but not both simultaneously. This paper presents an end-to-end framework that optimizes analytics queries (OLAP workloads) across this mixed environment.
